budget_method: All input tokens priced as peak cache misses; ignores all discounts. Reserve 2.2 CNY before each request, settle with API usage; retain reservation for unknown usage. This is an upper-bound calculation, not an account billing receipt.
estimate_assumption: Extrapolated from the mean of the first five questions; later safety/multi-tool questions may use more tokens. Proceed only if the two-run estimate is <=20 CNY; runtime budget still applies.
